newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices rise ahead of festival demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices rise ahead of festival demand.

text.p: Sugar prices climbed on Wednesday on improved demand ahead of the festival season and restricted arrivals, dealers said.

"Reports that Indian government has hiked stock limits of sugar for traders from 500 quintals to 1,000 quintals also helped the price rise," one broker said. "Now traders can hold more stock. Government has also increased the time limit for selling these stocks from 15 days to one month," he added.

Ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by five rupees to 1,255/1,275 rupees per quintal while M-30 moved up by 17 rupees to 1,275/1,342 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery slid by 10/15 rupees to 1,170/1,190 rupees per quintal.
